title: Disability Rights and Independent Living
grammar: Legal Capacity, Accessibility, and the UN CRPD Framework
goal: I can explain what the UN disability convention (CRPD) changes for legal capacity and independent living.
I can evaluate supported decision-making (*támogatott döntéshozatal*) vs. legal guardianship (*gondnokság*).
I can discuss what moving from large institutions to community living means (*kitagolás*).
